_comment: CLIP prompt bank for TrackSense AI (pipeline step 1).
Each category holds several phrasings of the same idea. At startup every phrase is
turned into a CLIP text embedding, the embeddings for a category are averaged, and the
average is re-normalised. That averaged vector is the 'prototype' for the category.
Prompt ensembling like this is measurably more stable than relying on one sentence.
You can edit these freely and restart the backend - no code changes needed.
Rules: keep exactly the three categories 'dry', 'damp' and 'wet', and keep at least
one phrase in each. 3-4 phrases per category is the sweet spot.

dry: dry road surface in bright sunlight
grey dry tarmac with no reflections
a dusty dry racing circuit in good conditions
damp: slightly wet asphalt with patchy moisture
a road drying after rain with dark damp patches
greasy damp tarmac with a few small wet spots
wet: standing water on asphalt with bright reflections
heavy rain on a road with visible spray
a flooded racing circuit with deep puddles
